audit: Log agent id, tool name, requested path, decision, and reason for every call.
principle: Finance code is absent from this repo. The gateway enforces that absence. It does not rely on a prompt.
secret_rule: Never return a raw secret to an agent. Inject a short lived scoped token at request time only.
write_rule: Deny all direct writes. UI proposals only, as a draft branch, for human review. Never write to main.
